FAQs
  • Are all models free to use?

    All models on build.nvidia.com are free to prototype with. Once you hit rate limits, see the Deploy section to use partner endpoints or deploy a NIM locally.

  • How many requests can I make?

    The free tier runs on rate limits - up to 40 requests per minute (RPM) for most models, with no per-token billing. Your personal rate limit is shown in the top-right of the dashboard.

  • Why are the API endpoints free?

    We believe open model inference offers the best cost-performance for most workloads. The free tier exists so you can verify that yourself before committing to anything.

  • How do I choose the right model?

    Each model page lists benchmarks, supported tasks, and context window. When in doubt, use the playground to test before you integrate.

  • How do I deploy to my own infrastructure?

    Download a NIM container and run it on your own cloud, via a CSP partner (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), or on a Brev GPU instance. The API is identical - no code changes required.

  • What is NemoClaw?

    NemoClaw is a sandboxed runtime for autonomous agents. Network requests, file access, and inference calls are all policy-gated. Nothing is permitted by default.

    kimi-k3

    Build a full-stack MVP web application for an AI-based cyber threat

    detection system that analyzes unidirectional (one-way) IP traffic.

    CONTEXT: This monitors traffic behind a data diode / unidirectional

    gateway — no return path, no TCP handshake completion, no session

    state. Detection relies purely on one-way flow features.

    BACKEND (Python/FastAPI):

    • Endpoint to ingest a PCAP file or simulated traffic stream

    • Feature extraction module: packet size distribution, inter-arrival

      timing, byte entropy, protocol field anomalies, flow rate/volume

      (explicitly exclude any feature requiring session/handshake state)

    • Anomaly detection using Isolation Forest (scikit-learn) — unsupervised,

      trained on "normal" traffic baseline

    • Classify flagged anomalies into categories: DDoS-like, port/network

      scan-like, protocol anomaly, potential exfiltration pattern

    • WebSocket or polling endpoint to stream alerts to the frontend in

      near-real-time

    • Return feature importance / contributing factors per alert for

      explainability

    • Auto-generated API docs (FastAPI's built-in Swagger/OpenAPI)

    FRONTEND (React + Tailwind):

    • Live dashboard: traffic volume chart, anomaly score chart over time

    • Alert feed: timestamp, threat type, confidence score, expandable to

      show which features triggered it

    • Filter by threat type and severity

    • "Simulate attack" button — lets me trigger a specific attack replay

      scenario live during a demo/judging Q&A instead of relying only on

      pre-recorded data

    • Basic login screen (even simple auth matters for a security tool —

      it's a bad look if a threat-detection product itself has none)

    • Dark, SOC-dashboard aesthetic (Splunk/Grafana style, not a generic

      admin template)

    ADDITIONAL FEATURES TO INCLUDE:

    • Configurable sensitivity/threshold controls in the UI, so I can show

      the precision/recall tradeoff live

    • A "generate report" button that exports a PDF summary of detected

      threats for a session — good artifact to show judges post-demo

    • Throughput/performance display (packets or flows processed per

      second) — gives you a concrete number when judges ask about scale

    • Unit tests for the feature extraction and detection logic

    CODE QUALITY:

    • Write clean, correct, working code — test the logic paths before

      finalizing, no placeholder/broken functions, no silent failures

    • No AI-generated tells: avoid over-commenting obvious lines, avoid

      generic variable names (data1, temp, result2), avoid boilerplate

      disclaimers in code comments. Comment only where the "why" isn't

      obvious from the code itself.

    • Modular structure — backend detection logic, feature extraction, and

      frontend cleanly separated so I can swap the model or add feature

      extractors without touching unrelated code

    • Consistent naming and formatting throughout (run a linter/formatter

      pass — black/ruff for Python, prettier for JS)

    README.md:

    Write it like a real engineer wrote it after finishing the project —

    natural language, no corporate/marketing tone, no emoji walls, no

    generic "This project is amazing and revolutionary" filler. Include:

    • A short, plain description of what the problem is and what this does

    • Why unidirectional traffic makes this different from a normal IDS

    • Setup/run instructions that actually work if someone follows them

      step by step (tested, not assumed)

    • A short section on current limitations (e.g. simulated data, not

      tested on live diode hardware) — judges respect honesty about scope

      more than overclaiming

    • Tech stack list, kept short

    class Pipeline:
    def __init__(self, settings):
        self.settings = settings
        self.aggregator = FlowAggregator(window_s=settings.window_s)
        self.detector = AnomalyDetector(...)
        self.classifier = ThreatClassifier()
        self.threshold = settings.alert_threshold
        self.alerts: deque[Alert] = deque(maxlen=500)
        self.stats = PipelineStats()
        self.subscribers: set[asyncio.Queue] = set()

    def train_baseline(self, packets):
    self.aggregator.reset()
    for pkt in packets: self.aggregator.add(pkt)
    windows = self.aggregator.flush_all()
    X = windows_to_matrix(windows)
    self.detector.fit(X)

    def ingest(self, packets) -> list[dict]:
    events = []
    for pkt in packets:
        closed = self.aggregator.add(pkt)  # returns closed windows list
        for window in closed:
            events.extend(self._score_window(window))
        self.stats.observe(pkt)
    return events

    def _score_window(self, window):
    vectors = window.feature_vectors()  # list[(meta, np.array)]
    if not vectors: return []
    X = np.stack([v for _, v in vectors])
    scores = self.detector.score(X)
    events = []
    for (meta, x), s in zip(vectors, scores):
        if s < self.threshold:
            alert = build_alert(...)
            self.alerts.append(alert)
            events.append({"type":"alert","payload":alert.model_dump()})
    events.append({"type":"window", "payload":{mean_score, min_score, ...}})
    return events

    def to_features(self, ctx) -> dict[str,float]:
    n=len(self.sizes); total=sum(self.sizes)
    dur=max(self.last_ts-self.first_ts, 1e-3)
    pps=n/dur; bps=total/dur
    mean=total/n
    var = sum((s-mean)**2 for s in self.sizes)/n if n>1 else 0.0
    std=sqrt(var)
    iat_mean = sum(iats)/len(iats) if iats else 0.0 (sec) → store ms ×1000
    iat_std similarly; iat_cv = iat_std/iat_mean if iat_mean>0 else 0
    entropy via sample; payload_ratio = payload_bytes/byte_total(guard 0)
    small_pkt_ratio = count(s<100)/n
    syn_ratio = syn_count/n (syn w/o ack counted in add: flags SYN set, ACK unset)
    fanouts from ctx

        if pkt.protocol == "TCP" and pkt.tcp_flags is not None:
            syn = bool(pkt.tcp_flags & 0x02)
            ack = bool(pkt.tcp_flags & 0x10)
            fin = bool(pkt.tcp_flags & 0x01)
            if syn and not ack:
                self.syn_count += 1
            if syn and fin:
                self.syn_fin = True
        if pkt.dst_port == 0 or pkt.src_port == 0:
            self.port_zero = True

        def to_features(self, ctx: "FlowContext") -> dict[str, float]:
        n = len(self.sizes)
        total = sum(self.sizes)
        duration = self.last_ts - self.first_ts
        rate_window = max(duration, MIN_RATE_WINDOW_S)
        mean = total / n
        variance = sum((s - mean) ** 2 for s in self.sizes) / n if n > 1 else 0.0
        iat_mean = sum(self.iats) / len(self.iats) if self.iats else 0.0
        iat_var = (
            sum((t - iat_mean) ** 2 for t in self.iats) / len(self.iats) if self.iats else 0.0
        )
        iat_std = math.sqrt(iat_var)
        return {
            "pkt_count": float(n),
            "byte_total": float(total),
            "duration_s": round(duration, 6),
            "pps": n / rate_window,
            "bps": total / rate_window,
            "pkt_size_mean": mean,
            "pkt_size_std": math.sqrt(variance),
            "pkt_size_min": float(min(self.sizes)),
            "pkt_size_max": float(max(self.sizes)),
            "iat_mean_ms": iat_mean * 1000.0,
            "iat_std_ms": iat_std * 1000.0,
            "iat_cv": (iat_std / iat_mean) if iat_mean > 0 else 0.0,
            "payload_entropy": shannon_entropy(self.sample),
            "payload_ratio": self.payload_bytes / total if total else 0.0,
            "small_pkt_ratio": sum(1 for s in self.sizes if s < 100) / n,
            "syn_ratio": self.syn_count / n,
            "src_port_fanout": float(ctx.src_port_fanout),
            "src_dst_fanout": float(ctx.src_dst_fanout),
            "dst_src_fanout": float(ctx.dst_src_fanout),
        }

    @dataclass
class FlowContext:
    src_port_fanout: int
    src_dst_fanout: int
    dst_src_fanout: int

    def __init__(self, window_s: float):
    if window_s <= 0:
        raise ValueError("window_s must be positive")
    self.window_s = window_s
    self._flows: dict[FlowKey, FlowRecord] = {}
    self._win_start: float | None = None
    self._win_end: float = 0.0

    def reset(self) -> None:
    self._flows.clear()
    self._win_start = None

    def add(self, pkt) -> list[list[ScoredFlow]]:
    if self._win_start is None:
        self._win_start = pkt.ts
        self._win_end = pkt.ts + self.window_s
    closed: list[list[ScoredFlow]] = []
    while pkt.ts >= self._win_end:
        closed.append(self._close_window(self._win_start, self._win_end))
        self._win_start = self._win_end
        self._win_end += self.window_s
    key = FlowKey(pkt.src_ip, pkt.dst_ip, pkt.src_port, pkt.dst_port, pkt.protocol)
    record = self._flows.get(key)
    if record is None:
        record = FlowRecord(key, pkt.ts)
        self._flows[key] = record
    record.add(pkt)
    return closed

        def flush(self) -> list[ScoredFlow]:
        """Force-close the open window (used by batch ingest at EOF)."""
        if self._win_start is None:
            return []
        closed = self._close_window(self._win_start, self._win_end)
        self._win_start = None
        self._flows.clear()
        return closed

    def _close_window(self, start: float, end: float) -> list[ScoredFlow]:
    flows = list(self._flows.values())
    self._flows = {}
    if not flows:
        return []
    ports_by_src: dict[str, set[int]] = defaultdict(set)
    dsts_by_src: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
    srcs_by_dst: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
    for record in flows:
        ports_by_src[record.key.src_ip].add(record.key.dst_port)
        dsts_by_src[record.key.src_ip].add(record.key.dst_ip)
        srcs_by_dst[record.key.dst_ip].add(record.key.src_ip)
    closed = []
    for record in flows:
        ctx = FlowContext(
            src_port_fanout=len(ports_by_src[record.key.src_ip]),
            src_dst_fanout=len(dsts_by_src[record.key.src_ip]),
            dst_src_fanout=len(srcs_by_dst[record.key.dst_ip]),
        )
        closed.append(
            ScoredFlow(
                key=record.key,
                features=record.to_features(ctx),
                flags={"syn_fin": record.syn_fin, "port_zero": record.port_zero},
                first_ts=record.first_ts,
                last_ts=record.last_ts,
            )
        )
    return closed

    @dataclass(frozen=True)
class Packet:
    ts: float
    src_ip: str
    dst_ip: str
    src_port: int
    dst_port: int
    protocol: str
    size: int
    payload: bytes = b""
    tcp_flags: int | None = None
    ttl: int | None = None

    from __future__ import annotations

    def fit(self, x: np.ndarray) -> None:
    if x.ndim != 2 or x.shape[1] != len(self.feature_names):
        raise ValueError(f"expected (n, {len(self.feature_names)}) matrix")
    if x.shape[0] < 10:
        raise ValueError("need at least 10 baseline samples")
    self.model.fit(x)
    self._median = np.median(x, axis=0)
    self._mean = x.mean(axis=0)
    self._std = x.std(axis=0) + 1e-9
    self.baseline_size = int(x.shape[0])
    self.trained = True

    def score(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Higher = more normal; negative values are statistical anomalies."""
    if not self.trained:
        raise RuntimeError("detector has not been fitted")
    return self.model.decision_function(x)

    def explain(self, row: np.ndarray, top_k: int = 5) -> dict:
    if not self.trained:
        raise RuntimeError("detector has not been fitted")
    base = float(self.score(row.reshape(1, -1))[0])
    deltas = np.zeros(len(self.feature_names))
    for i in range(len(self.feature_names)):
        patched = row.copy()
        patched[i] = self._median[i]
        deltas[i] = float(self.score(patched.reshape(1, -1))[0]) - base
    if np.any(deltas > 0):
        weights = np.clip(deltas, 0, None)
        method = "ablation"
    else:
        z = np.abs((row - self._mean) / self._std)
        weights = z
        method = "deviation"
    order = np.argsort(weights)[::-1][:top_k]
    total = weights[order].sum() or 1.0
    return {
        "method": method,
        "base_score": base,
        "contributions": [
            {
                "feature": self.feature_names[i],
                "weight": round(float(weights[i] / total), 4),
                "value": round(float(row[i]), 4),
                "baseline": round(float(self._median[i]), 4),
            }
            for i in order
        ],
    }

                f"source contacted {f['src_port_fanout']:.0f} distinct destination ports in one window",
                f"mean packet size {f['pkt_size_mean']:.0f}B with payload ratio {f['payload_ratio']:.2f} (probe traffic)",
            ]
            if f["syn_ratio"] > 0.5:
                reasons.append(f"{f['syn_ratio'] * 100:.0f}% of packets are bare SYN probes")
            return Classification(CATEGORY_SCAN, reasons)
        if f["src_dst_fanout"] >= 15 and f["pkt_size_mean"] <= SCAN_MAX_MEAN_SIZE:
            return Classification(CATEGORY_SCAN, [f"source swept {f['src_dst_fanout']:.0f} distinct hosts with small probe packets"])
        return None

            if f["dst_src_fanout"] >= DDOS_MIN_PEER_FANOUT:
            return Classification(CATEGORY_DDOS, [
                f"{f['dst_src_fanout']:.0f} distinct sources converged on this destination in one window",
                f"payload ratio {f['payload_ratio']:.2f} and mean size {f['pkt_size_mean']:.0f}B indicate flood traffic, not transfers",
            ])
        if f["pps"] >= DDOS_MIN_PPS and f["small_pkt_ratio"] >= DDOS_MIN_SMALL_PKT_RATIO:

    class TrafficSimulator:
    def __init__(self, seed: int = 7):
        self.rng = random.Random(seed)
        self._flows: list[_Flow] = []
        self._attacks: list[dict] = []  # {"name","gen","state","until"}

    def activate(self, scenario: str, duration_s: float, now: float | None = None) -> dict:
    now = now or time.time()
    gen, state = _ATTACK_BUILDERS[scenario](self.rng)
    entry = {"scenario": scenario, "gen": gen, "state": state, "until": now + duration_s}
    self._attacks.append(entry)
    return {"scenario": scenario, "until": entry["until"]}

    def tick(self, dt: float, now: float | None = None) -> list[Packet]:
    now = now or time.time()
    rng = self.rng
    packets: list[Packet] = []
    self._spawn_normal(now)
    for flow in self._flows:
        packets.extend(flow.emit(rng, now, dt))
    self._flows = [f for f in self._flows if f.expires > now]
    for attack in self._attacks:
        packets.extend(attack["gen"](rng, now, dt, attack["state"]))
    self._attacks = [a for a in self._attacks if a["until"] > now]
    packets.sort(key=lambda p: p.ts)
    return packets

    out = []
    try:
        steps = int(seconds / 0.5)
        t = start_ts
        for _ in range(steps):
            out.extend(self.tick(0.5, now=t))
            t += 0.5
    finally:
        self._flows = saved_flows
    return out

    # -- training ---------------------------------------------------------
def fit_baseline(self, packets) -> int:
    agg = FlowAggregator(self.cfg.window_s)
    flows: list[ScoredFlow] = []
    for pkt in packets:
        for window in agg.add(pkt):
            flows.extend(window)
    flows.extend(agg.flush())
    matrix = flows_to_matrix(flows)
    self.detector.fit(matrix)
    return int(matrix.shape[0])

    # -- live path ----------------------------------------------------------
def ingest_live(self, packets) -> list[dict]:
    events: list[dict] = []
    for pkt in packets:
        self.stats.packets_total += 1
        self.stats.bytes_total += pkt.size
        for window in self.aggregator.add(pkt):
            events.extend(self._score_window(window))
    return events

    # -- batch path (pcap upload) ------------------------------------------
def ingest_batch(self, packets) -> dict:
    agg = FlowAggregator(self.cfg.window_s)
    alerts_before = self.stats.alerts_total
    events = []
    for pkt in packets:
        self.stats.packets_total += 1
        self.stats.bytes_total += pkt.size
        for window in agg.add(pkt):
            events.extend(self._score_window(window))
    events.extend(self._score_window(agg.flush()))
    new_alerts = self.stats.alerts_total - alerts_before
    return {"packets": len(packets), "windows": ..., "alerts": new_alerts}

        def _build_alert(self, flow, row, score, window_ts) -> dict:
        explain = self.detector.explain(row)
        cls = self.classifier.classify(flow)
        depth = self.threshold - score
        confidence = 1.0 - math.exp(-8.0 * depth)
        severity = ("critical" if confidence >= 0.9 else "high" if confidence >= 0.75
                    else "medium" if confidence >= 0.5 else "low")
        key = flow.key
        return {
            "id": uuid.uuid4().hex[:12],
            "ts": window_ts,
            "src_ip": key.src_ip, "dst_ip": key.dst_ip,
            "src_port": key.src_port, "dst_port": key.dst_port,
            "protocol": key.protocol,
            "category": cls.category, "severity": severity,
            "confidence": round(confidence, 3),
            "score": round(score, 4), "threshold": self.threshold,
            "reasons": cls.reasons,
            "explanation": explain,
            "features": {name: round(float(flow.features[name]), 4) for name in FEATURE_NAMES},
            "window": {"first_ts": flow.first_ts, "last_ts": flow.last_ts},
            "summary": build_summary(...)
        }

    from __future__ import annotations

    def _decode_frame(frame, linktype, ts):
    if linktype == LINKTYPE_ETHERNET:
        if len(frame) < 14:
            return None
        eth_type = struct.unpack_from("!H", frame, 12)[0]
        pos = 14
        while eth_type == 0x8100 and len(frame) >= pos + 4:  # stacked 802.1Q tags
            eth_type = struct.unpack_from("!H", frame, pos + 2)[0]
            pos += 4
        if eth_type != 0x0800:
            return None
    elif linktype == LINKTYPE_RAW:
        if not frame:
            return None
        pos = 0
        if frame[0] >> 4 != 4:
            return None
    else:  # LINUX_SLL
        if len(frame) < 16 or struct.unpack_from("!H", frame, 14)[0] != 0x0800:
            return None
        pos = 16
    return _decode_ipv4(frame, pos, ts)

    def _decode_ipv4(buf, off, ts):
    if len(buf) - off < 20:
        return None
    ihl = (buf[off] & 0x0F) * 4
    if ihl < 20 or len(buf) - off < ihl:
        return None
    total_len = struct.unpack_from("!H", buf, off + 2)[0]
    proto = buf[off + 9]
    ttl = buf[off + 8]
    src = socket.inet_ntoa(buf[off + 12:off + 16])
    dst = socket.inet_ntoa(buf[off + 16:off + 20])
    end = off + total_len if 20 <= total_len <= len(buf) - off else len(buf)
    l4 = off + ihl
    ...
    if proto == 6:
        if end - l4 < 20: ports... return Packet(... protocol TCP but ports 0)?? need >=4 bytes for ports; flags needs 14.
        sport, dport = struct.unpack_from("!HH", buf, l4)
        flags = buf[l4 + 13] if end - l4 >= 14 else None
        data_off = (buf[l4 + 12] >> 4) * 4 if end - l4 >= 13 else 20
        payload = buf[l4 + data_off:end] if end - l4 >= data_off else b""
        return Packet(ts, src, dst, sport, dport, "TCP", total_len or (end-off), payload, flags, ttl)
    elif proto == 17:

    @app.post("/api/ingest/pcap")
async def ingest_pcap(file: UploadFile, _=Depends(require_auth)):
    data = await file.read(settings.max_pcap_bytes + 1)
    if len(data) > settings.max_pcap_bytes:
        raise HTTPException(413, f"capture exceeds {settings.max_pcap_bytes // (1024 * 1024)}MB limit")
    try:
        packets = parse_pcap(data)
    except UnsupportedFormat as exc:
        raise HTTPException(422, str(exc))
    except PcapError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(400, f"could not parse capture: {exc}")
    if not packets:
        return {"packets": 0, "windows": 0, "alerts": 0, "detail": "no IPv4 TCP/UDP/ICMP packets found"}
    before_windows = pipeline.stats.windows_total
    summary = pipeline.ingest_batch(packets)
    for alert in list(pipeline.alerts)[-summary["alerts"]:] if summary["alerts"] else []:
        pipeline.bus.publish({"type": "alert", "payload": alert})

    @app.websocket("/ws")
async def ws(websocket: WebSocket, token: str | None = Query(default=None)):
    if not token_valid(token):
        await websocket.close(code=4401)
        return
    await websocket.accept()
    queue = pipeline.bus.subscribe()
    try:
        await websocket.send_json({"type": "hello", "payload": {
            "threshold": pipeline.threshold,
            "threshold_bounds": [settings.threshold_min, settings.threshold_max],
            "window_s": settings.window_s,
            "trained": pipeline.detector.trained,
            "features": FEATURE_NAMES,
        }})
        while True:
            event = await queue.get()
            await websocket.send_json(event)
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        pipeline.bus.unsubscribe(queue)

    export default function SensitivityControl({ token, threshold, bounds }) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(threshold);
  const savedRef = useRef(threshold);
  useEffect(() => setValue(threshold), [threshold]);
  const debounce = useRef();
  const onChange = (e) => {
    const v = parseFloat(e.target.value);
    setValue(v);
    clearTimeout(debounce.current);
    debounce.current = setTimeout(() => { setThreshold(token, v).catch(() => {}); }, 250);
  };

        def ingest_batch(self, packets) -> tuple[dict, list[dict]]:
        agg = FlowAggregator(self.cfg.window_s)
        events: list[dict] = []
        for pkt in packets:
            self.stats.packets_total += 1
            self.stats.bytes_total += pkt.size
            for window in agg.add(pkt):
                events.extend(self._score_window(window))
        events.extend(self._score_window(agg.flush()))
        alerts = [e["payload"] for e in events if e["type"] == "alert"]
        return {"packets": len(packets), "alerts": len(alerts)}, alerts

    def _decode_ipv4(buf: bytes, off: int, ts: float) -> Packet | None:
    if len(buf) - off < 20:
        return None
    ihl = (buf[off] & 0x0F) * 4
    if ihl < 20 or len(buf) - off < ihl:
        return None
    total_len = struct.unpack_from("!H", buf, off + 2)[0]
    proto = buf[off + 9]
    ttl = buf[off + 8]
    src = socket.inet_ntoa(buf[off + 12:off + 16])
    dst = socket.inet_ntoa(buf[off + 16:off + 20])
    if total_len < ihl or total_len > len(buf) - off:
        end = len(buf)
        size = len(buf) - off
    else:
        end = off + total_len
        size = total_len
    l4 = off + ihl
    if proto == 6 and end - l4 >= 4:
        src_port, dst_port = struct.unpack_from("!HH", buf, l4)
        flags = buf[l4 + 13] if end - l4 >= 14 else None
        data_off = (buf[l4 + 12] >> 4) * 4 if end - l4 >= 13 else 20
        payload = buf[l4 + data_off:end] if end - l4 >= data_off else b""
        return Packet(ts, src, dst, src_port, dst_port, "TCP", size, payload, flags, ttl)
    if proto == 17 and end - l4 >= 8:
        src_port, dst_port = struct.unpack_from("!HH", buf, l4)
        return Packet(ts, src, dst, src_port, dst_port, "UDP", size, buf[l4 + 8:end], None, ttl)
    if proto == 1:
        return Packet(ts, src, dst, 0, 0, "ICMP", size, b"", None, ttl)
    return Packet(ts, src, dst, 0, 0, f"IP{proto}", size, b"", None, ttl)

    flags position: TCP header bytes: 0-3 ports, 4-7 seq, 8-11 ack, 12 data offset/flags hi, 13 flags, 14-15 window ✓.

    SPAWN_RATES = {"web": 1.2, "dns": 1.6, "api": 0.9, "file": 0.12, "iot": 0.25, "ntp": 0.05}

    class _Flow:
    __slots__ = ("kind", "src_ip", "dst_ip", "src_port", "dst_port", "protocol",
                 "pps", "size_lo", "size_hi", "payload_kind", "style", "expires")

    def __init__(self, rng, kind, now):
    params = _KIND_PARAMS[kind]
    self.kind = kind
    self.src_ip = rng.choice(INTERNAL_HOSTS)
    self.dst_ip = params["dst"](rng)
    self.src_port = rng.randrange(49152, 65000)
    self.dst_port = params["port"](rng)
    self.protocol = params["protocol"]
    self.pps = rng.uniform(*params["pps"])
    self.size_lo, self.size_hi = params["size"]
    self.payload_kind = params["payload"]
    self.style = params["style"]
    self.expires = now + rng.uniform(*params["ttl"])

    def emit(self, rng, now, dt):
    mean = self.pps * dt
    n = max(0, round(rng.gauss(mean, math.sqrt(mean)))) if mean >= 1 else (1 if rng.random() < mean else 0)
    if n == 0:
        return []
    base = now - dt
    if self.style == "steady":
        step = dt / n
        times = [base + (i + 0.5) * step + rng.gauss(0.0, step * 0.02) for i in range(n)]
    else:
        times = sorted(base + rng.random() * dt for _ in range(n))
    header = _TCP_HDR if self.protocol == "TCP" else _UDP_HDR
    packets = []
    for ts in times:
        size = rng.randint(self.size_lo, self.size_hi)
        payload = self._payload(rng, max(size - header, 0))
        packets.append(Packet(ts=ts, src_ip=self.src_ip, dst_ip=self.dst_ip,
                              src_port=self.src_port, dst_port=self.dst_port,
                              protocol=self.protocol, size=size, payload=payload,
                              tcp_flags=0x18 if self.protocol == "TCP" else None, ttl=64))
    return packets

    def _payload(self, rng, length):
    if length <= 0 or self.payload_kind == "none":
        return b""
    if self.payload_kind == "random":
        return rng.randbytes(length)
    offset = rng.randrange(0, len(TEXT_POOL) - 1)
    chunk = TEXT_POOL[offset:offset + length]
    if len(chunk) < length:                      # wrap around the pool
        chunk += TEXT_POOL[:length - len(chunk)]
    return chunk

    TEXT_POOL length: build base ~ (90 string chars..) PRINTABLE ~ 95 chars + header text ~ 100 → *4 ≈ 780 bytes? length up to 1420 → wrap handles ✓ with pool ≥ 1. ✓ chunk could double-count entropy whatever.

        def _spawn_normal(self, now, dt):
        for kind, rate in SPAWN_RATES.items():
            if self.rng.random() < rate * dt:
                self._flows.append(_Flow(self.rng, kind, now))

    def _gen_port_scan(rng, now, dt, state):
    n = max(1, round(250 * dt))
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        port = state["next_port"]
        state["next_port"] = 1 if port >= 65000 else port + 1
        out.append(Packet(ts=now - dt + (i + rng.random()) * (dt / n),

                          dst_port=port, protocol="TCP", size=40, payload=b"",

async def ingest_pcap(file: UploadFile, _auth: str = Depends(require_auth)):
    data = await file.read(settings.max_pcap_bytes + 1)
    if len(data) > settings.max_pcap_bytes:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE, "capture exceeds 25MB limit")
    try:
        packets = parse_pcap(data)
    except UnsupportedFormat as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, str(exc)) from exc
    except PcapError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, f"could not parse capture: {exc}") from exc
    summary, alerts = pipeline.ingest_batch(packets)
    for alert in alerts[:100]:
        pipeline.bus.publish({"type": "alert", "payload": alert})
    summary["published_alerts"] = min(len(alerts), 100)

    from __future__ import annotations

    import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

    from typing import Literal

    import secrets
import time

    """Feature extraction for unidirectional flows.

    def __init__(self, key: FlowKey, ts: float):
    self.key = key
    self.first_ts = ts
    self.last_ts = ts
    self.sizes: list[int] = []
    self.iats: list[float] = []
    self.sample = bytearray()
    self.payload_bytes = 0
    self.syn_count = 0
    self.syn_fin = False
    self.port_zero = False

    def add(self, pkt: Packet) -> None:
    if self.sizes:
        self.iats.append(max(pkt.ts - self.last_ts, 0.0))
    self.last_ts = pkt.ts
    self.sizes.append(pkt.size)
    if pkt.payload:
        self.payload_bytes += len(pkt.payload)
        if len(self.sample) < ENTROPY_SAMPLE_CAP:
            take = min(len(pkt.payload), ENTROPY_SAMPLE_PER_PACKET,
                       ENTROPY_SAMPLE_CAP - len(self.sample))
            self.sample += pkt.payload[:take]
    if pkt.protocol == "TCP" and pkt.tcp_flags is not None:
        syn = bool(pkt.tcp_flags & 0x02)
        if syn and not pkt.tcp_flags & 0x10:  # SYN without ACK: probe or flood
            self.syn_count += 1
        if syn and pkt.tcp_flags & 0x01:  # SYN+FIN never happens in a real stack
            self.syn_fin = True
    if pkt.dst_port == 0 or pkt.src_port == 0:
        self.port_zero = True

    def to_features(self, ctx: FlowContext) -> dict[str, float]:
    n = len(self.sizes)
    total = sum(self.sizes)
    duration = self.last_ts - self.first_ts
    rate_window = max(duration, MIN_RATE_WINDOW_S)
    mean = total / n
    variance = sum((s - mean) ** 2 for s in self.sizes) / n if n > 1 else 0.0
    iat_mean = sum(self.iats) / len(self.iats) if self.iats else 0.0
    iat_var = (
        sum((t - iat_mean) ** 2 for t in self.iats) / len(self.iats) if self.iats else 0.0
    )
    iat_std = math.sqrt(iat_var)
    return {
        "pkt_count": float(n),
        "byte_total": float(total),
        "duration_s": round(duration, 6),
        "pps": n / rate_window,
        "bps": total / rate_window,
        "pkt_size_mean": mean,
        "pkt_size_std": math.sqrt(variance),
        "pkt_size_min": float(min(self.sizes)),
        "pkt_size_max": float(max(self.sizes)),
        "iat_mean_ms": iat_mean * 1000.0,
        "iat_std_ms": iat_std * 1000.0,
        "iat_cv": (iat_std / iat_mean) if iat_mean > 0 else 0.0,
        "payload_entropy": shannon_entropy(self.sample),
        "payload_ratio": self.payload_bytes / total if total else 0.0,
        "small_pkt_ratio": sum(1 for s in self.sizes if s < 100) / n,
        "syn_ratio": self.syn_count / n,
        "src_port_fanout": float(ctx.src_port_fanout),
        "src_dst_fanout": float(ctx.src_dst_fanout),
        "dst_src_fanout": float(ctx.dst_src_fanout),
    }

    def __init__(self, window_s: float):
    if window_s <= 0:
        raise ValueError("window_s must be positive")
    self.window_s = window_s
    self._flows: dict[FlowKey, FlowRecord] = {}
    self._win_start: float | None = None
    self._win_end: float = 0.0

    def reset(self) -> None:
    self._flows.clear()
    self._win_start = None

    def add(self, pkt: Packet) -> list[list[ScoredFlow]]:
    """Add a packet; return any windows that closed as a result."""
    if self._win_start is None:
        self._win_start = pkt.ts
        self._win_end = pkt.ts + self.window_s
    closed: list[list[ScoredFlow]] = []
    while pkt.ts >= self._win_end:
        closed.append(self._close_window())
        self._win_start = self._win_end
        self._win_end += self.window_s
    key = FlowKey(pkt.src_ip, pkt.dst_ip, pkt.src_port, pkt.dst_port, pkt.protocol)
    record = self._flows.get(key)
    if record is None:
        record = FlowRecord(key, pkt.ts)
        self._flows[key] = record
    record.add(pkt)
    return closed

    def flush(self) -> list[ScoredFlow]:
    """Force-close the open window (end of a batch/pcap)."""
    if self._win_start is None:
        return []
    closed = self._close_window()
    self._win_start = None
    return closed

    def _close_window(self) -> list[ScoredFlow]:
    records = list(self._flows.values())
    self._flows = {}
    if not records:
        return []
    ports_by_src: dict[str, set[int]] = defaultdict(set)
    dsts_by_src: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
    srcs_by_dst: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
    for record in records:
        ports_by_src[record.key.src_ip].add(record.key.dst_port)
        dsts_by_src[record.key.src_ip].add(record.key.dst_ip)
        srcs_by_dst[record.key.dst_ip].add(record.key.src_ip)
    return [
        ScoredFlow(
            key=record.key,
            features=record.to_features(
                FlowContext(
                    src_port_fanout=len(ports_by_src[record.key.src_ip]),
                    src_dst_fanout=len(dsts_by_src[record.key.src_ip]),
                    dst_src_fanout=len(srcs_by_dst[record.key.dst_ip]),
                )
            ),
            flags={"syn_fin": record.syn_fin, "port_zero": record.port_zero},
            first_ts=record.first_ts,
            last_ts=record.last_ts,
        )
        for record in records
    ]

    from __future__ import annotations

    def __init__(self, contamination: float = 0.06, n_estimators: int = 150, seed: int = 42):
    self.model = IsolationForest(
        n_estimators=n_estimators,
        contamination=contamination,
        random_state=seed,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    self.feature_names = list(FEATURE_NAMES)
    self.trained = False
    self.baseline_size = 0
    self._median: np.ndarray | None = None
    self._mean: np.ndarray | None = None
    self._std: np.ndarray | None = None

    def fit(self, x: np.ndarray) -> None:
    if x.ndim != 2 or x.shape[1] != len(self.feature_names):
        raise ValueError(f"expected an (n, {len(self.feature_names)}) matrix")
    if x.shape[0] < 10:
        raise ValueError("need at least 10 baseline samples")
    self.model.fit(x)
    self._median = np.median(x, axis=0)
    self._mean = x.mean(axis=0)
    self._std = x.std(axis=0) + 1e-9
    self.baseline_size = int(x.shape[0])
    self.trained = True

    def score(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Higher is more normal; values below the decision threshold are anomalous."""
    if not self.trained:
        raise RuntimeError("detector has not been fitted")
    return self.model.decision_function(x)

    def explain(self, row: np.ndarray, top_k: int = 5) -> dict:
    """Rank features by how much they pull the score down.

        Primary method is ablation: reset one feature to its baseline median and
    measure the score recovery. If nothing recovers (rare, e.g. a purely
    multivariate outlier), fall back to z-score deviation from baseline.
    """
    if not self.trained:
        raise RuntimeError("detector has not been fitted")
    base = float(self.score(row.reshape(1, -1))[0])
    deltas = np.zeros(len(self.feature_names))
    for i in range(len(self.feature_names)):
        patched = row.copy()
        patched[i] = self._median[i]
        deltas[i] = float(self.score(patched.reshape(1, -1))[0]) - base
    if np.any(deltas > 0):
        weights = np.clip(deltas, 0.0, None)
        method = "ablation"
    else:
        weights = np.abs((row - self._mean) / self._std)
        method = "deviation"
    order = np.argsort(weights)[::-1][:top_k]
    total = weights[order].sum() or 1.0
    return {
        "method": method,
        "base_score": round(base, 4),
        "contributions": [
            {
                "feature": self.feature_names[i],
                "weight": round(float(weights[i] / total), 4),
                "value": round(float(row[i]), 4),
                "baseline": round(float(self._median[i]), 4),
            }
            for i in order
        ],
    }

    from __future__ import annotations

    Precedence matters: fan-out signatures (scan, DDoS) are more specific than
single-flow rate/volume rules, so they run first. A flagged flow that
matches nothing stays unclassified rather than forcing a wrong label.
"""

    def classify(self, flow: ScoredFlow) -> Classification:
    for rule in (self._scan, self._ddos, self._exfil, self._protocol):
        result = rule(flow)
        if result is not None:
            return result
    return Classification(
        category=None,
        reasons=["no category signature matched; flagged on statistical deviation alone"],
    )

    def _scan(self, flow: ScoredFlow) -> Classification | None:
    f = flow.features
    if f["src_port_fanout"] >= SCAN_MIN_PORT_FANOUT and f["pkt_size_mean"] <= SCAN_MAX_MEAN_SIZE:
        reasons = [
            f"source touched {f['src_port_fanout']:.0f} distinct destination ports in one window",
            f"mean packet size {f['pkt_size_mean']:.0f}B, payload ratio {f['payload_ratio']:.2f} (probes, not data)",
        ]
        if f["syn_ratio"] > 0.5:
            reasons.append(f"{f['syn_ratio'] * 100:.0f}% of packets are bare SYNs")
        return Classification(CATEGORY_SCAN, reasons)
    if f["src_dst_fanout"] >= 15 and f["pkt_size_mean"] <= SCAN_MAX_MEAN_SIZE:
        return Classification(
            CATEGORY_SCAN,
            [f"source swept {f['src_dst_fanout']:.0f} distinct hosts with small probe packets"],
        )
    return None

    def _ddos(self, flow: ScoredFlow) -> Classification | None:
    f = flow.features
    if f["dst_src_fanout"] >= DDOS_MIN_PEER_FANOUT:
        return Classification(
            CATEGORY_DDOS,
            [
                f"{f['dst_src_fanout']:.0f} distinct sources converged on this destination in one window",
                f"payload ratio {f['payload_ratio']:.2f}, mean size {f['pkt_size_mean']:.0f}B (flood shape, not a transfer)",
            ],
        )
    if f["pps"] >= DDOS_MIN_PPS and f["small_pkt_ratio"] >= DDOS_MIN_SMALL_PKT_RATIO:
        return Classification(
            CATEGORY_DDOS,
            [
                f"sustained {f['pps']:.0f} packets/s inside one unidirectional flow",
                f"{f['small_pkt_ratio'] * 100:.0f}% of packets under 100B",
            ],
        )
    return None

    def _exfil(self, flow: ScoredFlow) -> Classification | None:
    f = flow.features
    if (
        f["bps"] >= EXFIL_MIN_BPS
        and f["payload_entropy"] >= EXFIL_MIN_ENTROPY
        and f["iat_cv"] <= EXFIL_MAX_IAT_CV
    ):
        return Classification(
            CATEGORY_EXFIL,
            [
                f"sustained {f['bps'] / 1000:.0f} KB/s outbound in one direction",
                f"payload entropy {f['payload_entropy']:.2f} bits/byte (encrypted/compressed-looking content)",
                f"inter-arrival CV {f['iat_cv']:.2f}: metronome pacing typical of scripted transfer",
            ],
        )
    return None

    def _protocol(self, flow: ScoredFlow) -> Classification | None:
    if flow.flags.get("syn_fin"):
        return Classification(
            CATEGORY_PROTOCOL,
            ["packets carry SYN+FIN together, which no legitimate TCP stack emits"],
        )
    if flow.flags.get("port_zero"):
        return Classification(
            CATEGORY_PROTOCOL,
            ["traffic uses port 0, which is reserved and unroutable for real services"],
        )
    return None

    """Traffic generator: a plausible enterprise baseline plus attack overlays.

    def __init__(self, rng: random.Random, kind: str, now: float):
    params = _KIND_PARAMS[kind]
    self.kind = kind
    self.src_ip = rng.choice(INTERNAL_HOSTS)
    self.dst_ip = params["dst"](rng)
    self.src_port = rng.randrange(49152, 65000)
    self.dst_port = params["port"](rng)
    self.protocol = params["protocol"]
    self.pps = rng.uniform(*params["pps"])
    self.size_lo, self.size_hi = params["size"]
    self.payload_kind = params["payload"]
    self.style = params["style"]
    self.expires = now + rng.uniform(*params["ttl"])

    def emit(self, rng: random.Random, now: float, dt: float) -> list[Packet]:
    mean = self.pps * dt
    if mean >= 1:
        n = max(0, round(rng.gauss(mean, math.sqrt(mean))))
    else:
        n = 1 if rng.random() < mean else 0
    if n == 0:
        return []
    base = now - dt
    if self.style == "steady":
        step = dt / n
        times = [base + (i + 0.5) * step + rng.gauss(0.0, step * 0.02) for i in range(n)]
    else:
        times = sorted(base + rng.random() * dt for _ in range(n))
    header = _TCP_HDR if self.protocol == "TCP" else _UDP_HDR
    packets = []
    for ts in times:
        size = rng.randint(self.size_lo, self.size_hi)
        packets.append(
            Packet(
                ts=ts,
                src_ip=self.src_ip,
                dst_ip=self.dst_ip,
                src_port=self.src_port,
                dst_port=self.dst_port,
                protocol=self.protocol,
                size=size,
                payload=self._payload(rng, max(size - header, 0)),
                tcp_flags=0x18 if self.protocol == "TCP" else None,  # PSH|ACK data
                ttl=64,
            )
        )
    return packets

    def _payload(self, rng: random.Random, length: int) -> bytes:
    if length <= 0 or self.payload_kind == "none":
        return b""
    if self.payload_kind == "random":
        return rng.randbytes(length)
    offset = rng.randrange(0, len(_TEXT_POOL))
    chunk = _TEXT_POOL[offset:offset + length]
    if len(chunk) < length:
        chunk += _TEXT_POOL[:length - len(chunk)]
    return chunk

    def activate(self, scenario: str, duration_s: float, now: float | None = None) -> dict:
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    gen, state = _ATTACK_BUILDERS[scenario](self.rng)
    entry = {"scenario": scenario, "gen": gen, "state": state, "until": now + duration_s}
    self._attacks.append(entry)
    return {"scenario": scenario, "until": entry["until"]}

    def active_scenarios(self, now: float) -> list[str]:
    return [a["scenario"] for a in self._attacks if a["until"] > now]

    def tick(self, dt: float, now: float | None = None) -> list[Packet]:
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    packets: list[Packet] = []
    for kind, rate in SPAWN_RATES.items():
        if self.rng.random() < rate * dt:
            self._flows.append(_Flow(self.rng, kind, now))
    for flow in self._flows:
        packets.extend(flow.emit(self.rng, now, dt))
    self._flows = [f for f in self._flows if f.expires > now]
    for attack in self._attacks:
        packets.extend(attack["gen"](self.rng, now, dt, attack["state"]))
    self._attacks = [a for a in self._attacks if a["until"] > now]
    packets.sort(key=lambda p: p.ts)
    return packets

    def generate_baseline(self, seconds: float, start_ts: float = 1_000_000.0) -> list[Packet]:
    """Normal-only traffic on a fixed virtual clock, for model fitting."""
    live_flows, self._flows = self._flows, []
    out: list[Packet] = []
    try:
        steps = max(1, int(seconds / 0.5))
        t = start_ts
        for _ in range(steps):
            out.extend(self.tick(0.5, now=t))
            t += 0.5
    finally:
        self._flows = live_flows
    return out

    """Minimal classic-libpcap reader: Ethernet, raw IP and Linux SLL, IPv4 only.

    from __future__ import annotations

    def subscribe(self) -> asyncio.Queue:
    queue: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=500)
    self._subscribers.add(queue)
    return queue

    def unsubscribe(self, queue: asyncio.Queue) -> None:
    self._subscribers.discard(queue)

    def publish(self, event: dict) -> None:
    for queue in tuple(self._subscribers):
        try:
            queue.put_nowait(event)
        except asyncio.QueueFull:
            pass  # a stuck client drops ticks; full history stays in the alert buffer

    def snapshot(self) -> dict:
    uptime = max(time.time() - self.started_at, 1e-6)
    return {
        "started_at": self.started_at,
        "uptime_s": round(uptime, 1),
        "packets_total": self.packets_total,
        "bytes_total": self.bytes_total,
        "avg_pps": round(self.packets_total / uptime, 1),
        "windows_total": self.windows_total,
        "alerts_total": self.alerts_total,
        "suppressed_alerts": self.suppressed_alerts,
        "alerts_by_category": dict(self.alerts_by_category),
    }

    def __init__(self, cfg=settings):
    self.cfg = cfg
    self.aggregator = FlowAggregator(cfg.window_s)
    self.detector = AnomalyDetector(contamination=cfg.contamination)
    self.classifier = ThreatClassifier()
    self.threshold = cfg.alert_threshold
    self.alerts: deque[dict] = deque(maxlen=cfg.alert_buffer)
    self.stats = PipelineStats()
    self.bus = EventBus()

    def fit_baseline(self, packets: list[Packet]) -> int:
    agg = FlowAggregator(self.cfg.window_s)
    flows: list[ScoredFlow] = []
    for pkt in packets:
        for window in agg.add(pkt):
            flows.extend(window)
    flows.extend(agg.flush())
    self.detector.fit(flows_to_matrix(flows))
    return self.detector.baseline_size

    def ingest_live(self, packets: list[Packet]) -> list[dict]:
    events: list[dict] = []
    for pkt in packets:
        self.stats.packets_total += 1
        self.stats.bytes_total += pkt.size
        for window in self.aggregator.add(pkt):
            events.extend(self._score_window(window))
    return events

    def ingest_batch(self, packets: list[Packet]) -> tuple[dict, list[dict]]:
    """PCAP replay path: its own aggregator so live window state is untouched."""
    agg = FlowAggregator(self.cfg.window_s)
    events: list[dict] = []
    for pkt in packets:
        self.stats.packets_total += 1
        self.stats.bytes_total += pkt.size
        for window in agg.add(pkt):
            events.extend(self._score_window(window))
    events.extend(self._score_window(agg.flush()))
    alerts = [e["payload"] for e in events if e["type"] == "alert"]
    windows = sum(1 for e in events if e["type"] == "score")
    return {"packets": len(packets), "windows": windows, "alerts": len(alerts)}, alerts

    def _score_window(self, flows: list[ScoredFlow]) -> list[dict]:
    if not flows:
        return []
    self.stats.windows_total += 1
    window_ts = max(f.last_ts for f in flows)
    if not self.detector.trained:
        return [{"type": "score", "payload": {
            "ts": window_ts, "n_flows": len(flows), "mean_score": None, "min_score": None}}]
    matrix = flows_to_matrix(flows)
    scores = self.detector.score(matrix)
    events = [{"type": "score", "payload": {
        "ts": window_ts,
        "n_flows": len(flows),
        "mean_score": round(float(scores.mean()), 4),
        "min_score": round(float(scores.min()), 4),
    }}]
    below = np.flatnonzero(scores < self.threshold)
    if below.size:
        below = below[np.argsort(scores[below])]
        emitted = 0
        for idx in below:
            if emitted >= MAX_ALERTS_PER_WINDOW:
                break
            alert = self._build_alert(flows[idx], matrix[idx], float(scores[idx]), window_ts)
            self.alerts.append(alert)
            self.stats.alerts_total += 1
            self.stats.alerts_by_category[alert["category"] or "unclassified"] += 1
            events.append({"type": "alert", "payload": alert})
            emitted += 1
        self.stats.suppressed_alerts += int(below.size) - emitted
    return events

    def _build_alert(self, flow: ScoredFlow, row: np.ndarray, score: float, window_ts: float) -> dict:
    explanation = self.detector.explain(row)
    classification = self.classifier.classify(flow)
    depth = self.threshold - score
    confidence = 1.0 - math.exp(-8.0 * depth)
    severity = (
        "critical" if confidence >= 0.9 else
        "high" if confidence >= 0.75 else
        "medium" if confidence >= 0.5 else
        "low"
    )
    key = flow.key
    label = CATEGORY_LABELS.get(classification.category, "Unclassified anomaly")
    return {
        "id": uuid.uuid4().hex[:12],
        "ts": window_ts,
        "src_ip": key.src_ip,
        "dst_ip": key.dst_ip,
        "src_port": key.src_port,
        "dst_port": key.dst_port,
        "protocol": key.protocol,
        "category": classification.category,
        "severity": severity,
        "confidence": round(confidence, 3),
        "score": round(score, 4),
        "threshold": self.threshold,
        "summary": (
            f"{label}: {key.src_ip}:{key.src_port} -> {key.dst_ip}:{key.dst_port}/"
            f"{key.protocol} over {flow.last_ts - flow.first_ts:.1f}s"
        ),
        "reasons": classification.reasons,
        "explanation": explanation,
        "features": {name: round(float(flow.features[name]), 4) for name in FEATURE_NAMES},
    }

    # DiodeWatch

    packets (live simulator, or pcap upload)
  -> unidirectional flow aggregation (5-tuple, 3s tumbling windows)
  -> 19 one-way features per flow
  -> IsolationForest score (baseline fitted on normal traffic at startup)
  -> flows below the decision threshold become alerts
  -> rule-based category + per-feature contribution via ablation
  -> WebSocket push to the dashboard

    backend/app/security.py

    import secrets
import time

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer

from .config import settings

_tokens: dict[str, float] = {}
_bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)


def issue_token() -> str:
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    _tokens[token] = time.time() + settings.token_ttl_s
    return token


def token_valid(token: str | None) -> bool:
    if not token:
        return False
    expiry = _tokens.get(token)
    if expiry is None:
        return False
    if expiry < time.time():
        _tokens.pop(token, None)
        return False
    return True


def revoke(token: str) -> None:
    _tokens.pop(token, None)


async def require_auth(
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(_bearer),
) -> str:
    if credentials is None or not token_valid(credentials.credentials):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="invalid or expired token")
    return credentials.credentials

    backend/app/features/extractor.py — the heart of the "one-way only" constraint

    """Feature extraction for unidirectional flows.

Every feature here is computable from packets traveling in a single direction.
Anything that needs a handshake, reply traffic or session state is excluded
by construction: rates, size distribution, inter-arrival timing, payload
entropy, bare-SYN ratio and window-level source/destination fan-out.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np

from ..types import Packet

FEATURE_NAMES = [
    "pkt_count",
    "byte_total",
    "duration_s",
    "pps",
    "bps",
    "pkt_size_mean",
    "pkt_size_std",
    "pkt_size_min",
    "pkt_size_max",
    "iat_mean_ms",
    "iat_std_ms",
    "iat_cv",
    "payload_entropy",
    "payload_ratio",
    "small_pkt_ratio",
    "syn_ratio",
    "src_port_fanout",
    "src_dst_fanout",
    "dst_src_fanout",
]

# Rates are computed over at least one second so a lone packet doesn't read as "1000 pps".
MIN_RATE_WINDOW_S = 1.0
ENTROPY_SAMPLE_PER_PACKET = 256
ENTROPY_SAMPLE_CAP = 4096


def shannon_entropy(data: bytes | bytearray) -> float:
    if not data:
        return 0.0
    counts = [0] * 256
    for byte in data:
        counts[byte] += 1
    total = len(data)
    return -sum((c / total) * math.log2(c / total) for c in counts if c)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FlowKey:
    src_ip: str
    dst_ip: str
    src_port: int
    dst_port: int
    protocol: str


@dataclass
class FlowContext:
    """Window-level fan-out around a flow: what makes scans and floods visible."""
    src_port_fanout: int
    src_dst_fanout: int
    dst_src_fanout: int


@dataclass
class ScoredFlow:
    key: FlowKey
    features: dict[str, float]
    flags: dict[str, bool]
    first_ts: float
    last_ts: float


class FlowRecord:
    __slots__ = (
        "key", "last_ts", "first_ts", "sizes", "iats", "sample",
        "payload_bytes", "syn_count", "syn_fin", "port_zero",
    )

    def __init__(self, key: FlowKey, ts: float):
        self.key = key
        self.first_ts = ts
        self.last_ts = ts
        self.sizes: list[int] = []
        self.iats: list[float] = []
        self.sample = bytearray()
        self.payload_bytes = 0
        self.syn_count = 0
        self.syn_fin = False
        self.port_zero = False

    def add(self, pkt: Packet) -> None:
        if self.sizes:
            self.iats.append(max(pkt.ts - self.last_ts, 0.0))
        self.last_ts = pkt.ts
        self.sizes.append(pkt.size)
        if pkt.payload:
            self.payload_bytes += len(pkt.payload)
            if len(self.sample) < ENTROPY_SAMPLE_CAP:
                take = min(len(pkt.payload), ENTROPY_SAMPLE_PER_PACKET,
                           ENTROPY_SAMPLE_CAP - len(self.sample))
                self.sample += pkt.payload[:take]
        if pkt.protocol == "TCP" and pkt.tcp_flags is not None:
            syn = bool(pkt.tcp_flags & 0x02)
            if syn and not pkt.tcp_flags & 0x10:  # SYN without ACK: probe or flood
                self.syn_count += 1
            if syn and pkt.tcp_flags & 0x01:  # SYN+FIN never happens in a real stack
                self.syn_fin = True
        if pkt.dst_port == 0 or pkt.src_port == 0:
            self.port_zero = True

    def to_features(self, ctx: FlowContext) -> dict[str, float]:
        n = len(self.sizes)
        total = sum(self.sizes)
        duration = self.last_ts - self.first_ts
        rate_window = max(duration, MIN_RATE_WINDOW_S)
        mean = total / n
        variance = sum((s - mean) ** 2 for s in self.sizes) / n if n > 1 else 0.0
        iat_mean = sum(self.iats) / len(self.iats) if self.iats else 0.0
        iat_var = (
            sum((t - iat_mean) ** 2 for t in self.iats) / len(self.iats) if self.iats else 0.0
        )
        iat_std = math.sqrt(iat_var)
        return {
            "pkt_count": float(n),
            "byte_total": float(total),
            "duration_s": round(duration, 6),
            "pps": n / rate_window,
            "bps": total / rate_window,
            "pkt_size_mean": mean,
            "pkt_size_std": math.sqrt(variance),
            "pkt_size_min": float(min(self.sizes)),
            "pkt_size_max": float(max(self.sizes)),
            "iat_mean_ms": iat_mean * 1000.0,
            "iat_std_ms": iat_std * 1000.0,
            "iat_cv": (iat_std / iat_mean) if iat_mean > 0 else 0.0,
            "payload_entropy": shannon_entropy(self.sample),
            "payload_ratio": self.payload_bytes / total if total else 0.0,
            "small_pkt_ratio": sum(1 for s in self.sizes if s < 100) / n,
            "syn_ratio": self.syn_count / n,
            "src_port_fanout": float(ctx.src_port_fanout),
            "src_dst_fanout": float(ctx.src_dst_fanout),
            "dst_src_fanout": float(ctx.dst_src_fanout),
        }


class FlowAggregator:
    """Groups packets into unidirectional 5-tuple flows inside tumbling windows."""

    def __init__(self, window_s: float):
        if window_s <= 0:
            raise ValueError("window_s must be positive")
        self.window_s = window_s
        self._flows: dict[FlowKey, FlowRecord] = {}
        self._win_start: float | None = None
        self._win_end: float = 0.0

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._flows.clear()
        self._win_start = None

    def add(self, pkt: Packet) -> list[list[ScoredFlow]]:
        """Add a packet; return any windows that closed as a result."""
        if self._win_start is None:
            self._win_start = pkt.ts
            self._win_end = pkt.ts + self.window_s
        closed: list[list[ScoredFlow]] = []
        while pkt.ts >= self._win_end:
            closed.append(self._close_window())
            self._win_start = self._win_end
            self._win_end += self.window_s
        key = FlowKey(pkt.src_ip, pkt.dst_ip, pkt.src_port, pkt.dst_port, pkt.protocol)
        record = self._flows.get(key)
        if record is None:
            record = FlowRecord(key, pkt.ts)
            self._flows[key] = record
        record.add(pkt)
        return closed

    def flush(self) -> list[ScoredFlow]:
        """Force-close the open window (end of a batch/pcap)."""
        if self._win_start is None:
            return []
        closed = self._close_window()
        self._win_start = None
        return closed

    def _close_window(self) -> list[ScoredFlow]:
        records = list(self._flows.values())
        self._flows = {}
        if not records:
            return []
        ports_by_src: dict[str, set[int]] = defaultdict(set)
        dsts_by_src: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
        srcs_by_dst: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
        for record in records:
            ports_by_src[record.key.src_ip].add(record.key.dst_port)
            dsts_by_src[record.key.src_ip].add(record.key.dst_ip)
            srcs_by_dst[record.key.dst_ip].add(record.key.src_ip)
        return [
            ScoredFlow(
                key=record.key,
                features=record.to_features(
                    FlowContext(
                        src_port_fanout=len(ports_by_src[record.key.src_ip]),
                        src_dst_fanout=len(dsts_by_src[record.key.src_ip]),
                        dst_src_fanout=len(srcs_by_dst[record.key.dst_ip]),
                    )
                ),
                flags={"syn_fin": record.syn_fin, "port_zero": record.port_zero},
                first_ts=record.first_ts,
                last_ts=record.last_ts,
            )
            for record in records
        ]


def flows_to_matrix(flows: list[ScoredFlow]) -> np.ndarray:
    return np.array(
        [[flow.features[name] for name in FEATURE_NAMES] for flow in flows], dtype=float
    )
